messages:
alex_support: Heads up — DataHelix is hitting intermittent 5xx/timeouts on hosted inference since ~07:12 UTC. They report spikes of 503 on /v1/generate and their SDK is entering a retry loop. Sample curl and logs below.

alex_support: ```bash
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\\\" \\\n  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1-small\", \"input\": \"hello\"}'
```

alex_support: partial edge log excerpt:
```
edge-proxy-1 | 2026-03-17T07:14:03Z | tenant=datahelix | upstream: timeout after 32s -> 503
edge-proxy-1 | 2026-03-17T07:14:04Z | connection reset by peer during streaming
```

emily_cs: Customer says errors tend to happen after ~20-40 requests in a single session, sometimes 504 when payloads are large. They shared session id `sess-0xabc123`.

maria_oncall: Oncall here. Can someone confirm SDK version and whether they're using streaming + long request timeout?

alex_support: They're on SDK 1.2.3, using streaming=true and client timeout=60s. Also report: occasional 502s when auth rotates.

sam_sre: Sounds like ingress connection reuse or keepalive + long-lived streaming interaction. Any recent edge deploys?

deploy_bot: deploy_bot: deployment r2026.03.17.3 -> edge-us-west completed at 07:05 UTC :shipit:

lee_engineer: We've seen similar 503s when auth refresh triggers connection termination mid-stream. Jun — can you grep auth-service for refresh spikes for tenant `datahelix`?

jun_ml: Will do. Kicking off query for token-refresh events between 07:00-07:50 UTC and correlating with sess-0xabc123.

alex_support: Repro steps I ran locally to mimic: 1) create bearer token, 2) loop 50 requests with concurrency 10 against /v1/generate, streaming on. After ~30 requests we saw 503s. Logs: `upstream timeout after 32s` and `http2 stream reset`.

alex_support: ```
Repeat run snippet (pseudo):
for i in $(seq 1 50); do \\\curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"input\": \"x\"}' \\\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\\\" & done; wait
```

sam_sre: Short-term mitigation deployed: enabled automatic fallback to the smaller model-variant for this tenant and bumped burst capacity for edge-us-west. Also lowered edge idle keepalive to 20s for a test window. Notified customer.

emily_cs: Customer confirmed fewer 5xx after fallback (07:40 UTC) but they still see occasional 504s on large payloads. They're asking for ETA on root cause.

maria_oncall: Action items: (1) Jun to correlate auth refresh events with 503 timestamps, (2) Lee to audit edge keepalive/h2 window config and recent deploy diffs, (3) Alex to request SDK traces and any tcpdump from customer for sess-0xabc123. We'll reconvene in 1hr or when Jun has correlation.

alex_support: ACK — I'll collect SDK traces and ask customer for a pcap of the failing session.

sam_sre: Long-term: we should add a guard that gracefully fails streaming requests on auth rotation rather than reset, and add metrics to measure mid-stream auth churn.

emily_cs: I'll update the customer that we're investigating auth/edge interplay, that a temporary fallback reduced errors, and we'll follow up with timeline.

maria_oncall: Thanks team. Please paste any logs/traces here as you get them. :eyes:
